title: (2nd LD) Seoul shares soar over 4 pct to snap 3-day slide on tech rally, oil prices fall
caption:
The Korea Exchange activated a rare 'sidecar' freeze today as the KOSPI index surged over 4 percent. A rally in semiconductor shares and a sharp drop in oil prices helped the market snap a three-day losing streak.
